$comment: Generated by bootstrap.sh from a project at @@SOURCE_ROOT@@. Edit freely.
$comment_commit_skip_regex: The security pipeline does NOT skip any commit: fix:/chore:/refactor: messages may be the only signal of a security fix. Leave commit_skip_regex empty. (If you set it anyway, run.sh only force-skips commits that rename/move/delete nothing.)
$comment_scope: Optional pathspec: analyze only commits touching this subdirectory (e.g. 'src/'). Empty = whole tree.

limits.$comment: Context budget. profile 'default' = historical caps, compaction off. profile 'small' = preset for ~32k-context models: tighter caps on every injected blob plus history compaction (once a request reports prompt_tokens >= compact_threshold_tokens, older tool results are shrunk in place to compact_result_chars; the last compact_keep_groups rounds stay verbatim). Any explicit key here overrides the profile. Tune compact_threshold_tokens to your window (leave headroom for the reply).

snapshot.$comment: Snapshot deep-scan (run.sh --snapshot [REF]): scan the CURRENT tree at REF (default HEAD) for pre-existing vulnerabilities instead of replaying history - one planner request partitions the tree into modules, then one agent session per module scans it. The baseline jumps to REF; later runs analyze only NEW commits. planner_model: model for the one planner request ('' = llm.model). max_modules: cap on the module partition (excess merges into 'misc'). max_steps: per-module session step budget (0 = llm.max_steps_initial).

triage.$comment: Fast pre-filter (two-stage cascade) for large histories. When enabled, each commit first gets ONE cheap no-tools request (subject + message + name-status + the COMPLETE diff when it fits diff_chars) that must answer CLEARLY_IRRELEVANT before the commit is marked NO_VULN without a full session; SECURITY_RELEVANT or any doubt/parse failure/guard (root commit, renames/deletes, Pass-B keywords in the message, prior-run hints, diff over the cap) falls through to the FULL session, so recall is preserved. model: '' = llm.model - point it at a cheaper/faster model if the endpoint has one. irrelevant_globs: when EVERY changed file matches, skip with NO LLM call at all (docs/tests/assets); empty disables. prefetch_ahead: run.sh starts a background worker keeping triage decisions cached this many commits AHEAD of the walk (verdicts/triage/<sha>.json), so the cascade costs the main invocation zero LLM round-trips. diff_chars: 0 = AUTO - sized from the provider window discovered by the pipeline (~3 chars per input token minus reserve; conservative 16000 fallback until a window is learned); an explicit value always wins. Measured effect on a 634-commit walk: multi-step NO_VULN sessions dominated ~57% of total wall time.

validation.$comment: post-write records validation. mode: strict = remaining errors flip the verdict to ERROR (commit requeued); warn = report only; off. rounds: how many repair rounds the agent gets before the final verdict. path_check: severity of the 'cited repo path must exist in the worktree' check — 'warn' by default because vulnerability records legitimately cite HISTORICAL paths (the vulnerable file may no longer exist at later commits).
